faq.q: What are the typical MOQ and lead time?
faq.a: Standard MOQ is from 20 pcs and typical production lead time is around 45 days, subject to model, configuration and order quantity. Final terms are confirmed at the quotation stage.
Available test reports and compliance documentation vary by product and destination market. Contact Kang Cai to confirm which documents are available for your program and market.
OEM branding can be applied to product labels, the wireless remote, outer cartons and documentation. Specific options are confirmed by model and program.

faq.q: What should I provide before quotation?
faq.a: Your target market, required size, estimated quantity, upholstery and control preferences, plug and voltage, and the delivery date you need.
